diagnostics.message: module.secure_baseline creates organization-scoped resources (including the organization CloudTrail trail, the Config organization aggregator, and organization Access Analyzer analyzers) and reads the organization via data.aws_organizations_organization.org, but the example module call does not depend on aws_organizations_organization.org. Terraform can therefore start the module before the organization and its required service access principals exist.

The organization configuration aggregator uses aws_iam_role.config_organization through role_arn, but it does not wait for aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.config_organization. AWS Config must be able to assume that role with the AWSConfigRoleForOrganizations policy before the aggregator is created; otherwise creation can fail.
